slides.label: Verse 1
lines: You are the love of my life
You are my joy and delight
You gave me life and Your love
The greatest love I’ve ever known

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: I’ll sing Your praise in all the earth
I’ll tell of Your works
Tell of Your greatness and wonders

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: The heavens declare Your glory
the stars proclaim
The works of Your hands
There is no speech nor language

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Where their voice is not heard
Day after day and night after night
Your knowledge is displayed
let Your praise fill all of the earth

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: The One who made all men
With the strings, harps and tambourines
We give You all the praise
Glorious You are, my God

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: The wonder of all ages You are
You are so big
The greatest You are
Ah ah ah ah ah

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: You are highest
You are the biggest
You are greatest of all kings
